response:
关闭“启用明细”后，明细字段会隐藏，但内容仍会保留，并且不参与必填校验；按钮只会生成一份可编辑草稿，需要你确认后才会发送。

```kelivo-ui
ui 1 catalog "kelivo.native/1"
root = Column(children=[form, ask])
$on: boolean = false
$name: string = ""
$detail: string = "保留内容"
form = Form(children=[toggle, nameField, detailField], title="机构报销条件")
toggle = Switch(bind=$on, label="启用明细")
nameField = TextField(bind=$name, label="名称", required=true, placeholder="请输入名称")
detailField = TextField(bind=$detail, label="明细", required=true, visible=$on, placeholder="请输入明细")
ask = Button(label="准备检查草稿", form=form, action=Ask(text="请检查这份机构报销条件表单草稿；它尚未发送。", context={"name":$name,"enabled":$on,"detail":$detail}))
```
